title.narrative: GIZ Water Sector Access to Climate Finance

description.narrative: GIZ Jordan would like to partner with Jordan country office to deliver: 1) capacity building on access to climate finance for the water sector in Jordan (to include Ministry of Water and Irrigation, Water Authority of Jordan, and all public and private water utilities and 2) a pipeline of 3-5 bankable concept notes (technical studies to be conducted by their consultants) for bankable water projects for submission to GCF or other climate funds. Total budget is estimated between $750K-950K to be determined based on a non-compete detailed budget and technical proposal developed by GGGI.
